incident.acceptance_step: eval-suite development baseline (not an acceptance step)

stimulus.question: Checkout is reported to show elevated errors in the OTel Demo. Using the authorized metrics range query and trace search for the last 5 minutes, determine whether checkout and its dependency calls (payment, product-catalog, cart, currency, shipping, email) show failures or elevated latency, cite trace ids, and return a json investigation report.

claims.text: In the 5-minute window 2026-11-03T11:58:32Z-12:03:32Z, sum by (service_name,status_code) of increase(traces_span_metrics_calls_total[300s]) returns service_name="checkout" status_code="STATUS_CODE_ERROR" = 0; the only non-zero checkout series is STATUS_CODE_UNSET = 62.4997 span-count per 5 min. Checkout's STATUS_CODE_ERROR series is also 0 at every 10-minute step from 2026-11-03T10:03:32Z to 12:03:32Z.

All checkout outbound gRPC calls in the last 5 minutes carry rpc_grpc_status_code="0": oteldemo.PaymentService/Charge 7.5, oteldemo.CurrencyService/Convert 21.25, oteldemo.CartService/EmptyCart 7.5, oteldemo.CartService/GetCart 7.5, oteldemo.ProductCatalogService/GetProduct 13.75, oteldemo.ShippingService/GetQuote 7.5, oteldemo.ShippingService/ShipOrder 7.5 (increase of rpc_client_duration_milliseconds_count per 5 min), while the oteldemo.PaymentService/Charge status-code-2 series and oteldemo.CartService/EmptyCart status-code-9 series are 0.

Checkout's own server-side oteldemo.CheckoutService/PlaceOrder shows increase(rpc_server_duration_milliseconds_count{service_name="checkout"}[300s]) = 7.5 at rpc_grpc_status_code="0" and 0 at rpc_grpc_status_code="13" in the last 5 minutes.

Dependency error status in the last 5 minutes: cart STATUS_CODE_ERROR = 0 and payment STATUS_CODE_ERROR = 0; the per-span ERROR series checkout:oteldemo.CartService/EmptyCart, checkout:oteldemo.CheckoutService/PlaceOrder, checkout:oteldemo.PaymentService/Charge and payment:grpc.oteldemo.PaymentService/Charge are all 0. No STATUS_CODE_ERROR series was returned for product-catalog, shipping or email (only STATUS_CODE_UNSET: 122.4995, 14.9999, 19.9999 respectively), and currency's only status series was STATUS_CODE_OK = 13.7499, so those services' error status is unobserved rather than zero.

In the 30 checkout traces sampled between 11:58:39Z and 12:02:13Z (300 spans; 200 rows read), no span carried an error status tag. Checkout PlaceOrder server spans measured 54,310 / 70,530 / 95,167 / 125,911 us with rpc.grpc.status_code=0 in traces 8f7540def937a4a9adff0c25331201e2, 9395596c997c9deb88bccf1c046527c7, 5ed435003f9e7b289756fa3d4114ae4f, 4b2c7fe3755af24bb49dc61c6c606fca, 7d72d605d972443ebf60c8ad0b71026c and 747810447e5bb175b88dde945aba2e07; checkout's HTTP POST spans returned http.status_code=200, and load-generator POST, frontend-proxy ingress and frontend POST /api/checkout spans in the same traces returned 200.

Dependency call durations in the same checkout trace sample are small and carry success status: checkout client oteldemo.PaymentService/Charge 1,577-28,002 us (parent span 0b92df482a67f12c), oteldemo.ProductCatalogService/GetProduct 433-1,577 us with product-catalog server spans 22-782 us, oteldemo.CartService/GetCart 781-3,915 us, oteldemo.CurrencyService/Convert 649-6,911 us (recorded as otel.status_code=OK, rpc.grpc.status_code=0), oteldemo.ShippingService/GetQuote 1,846-26,779 us, oteldemo.ShippingService/ShipOrder 196-2,891 us, and email sinatra.render_template 88-790 us with no status tag; no error detail field was present on any read row. Email's parent edge is not visible in the rows read, so that specific call edge remains unknown.

Checkout server p95 latency (histogram_quantile(0.95) over a 10-minute rate of rpc_server_duration_milliseconds_bucket{service_name="checkout"}) reads 221.87 ms in the window ending 12:03:32Z; over the preceding 8 hours the same expression ranges 70.83-221.87 ms, including 201.25 ms at ~11:03Z and 219.99999 ms at ~10:33Z, so the last reading is the top of an existing oscillation rather than a new level.

Checkout's client-observed average latency per dependency stays inside its own baseline: oteldemo.PaymentService 12.82 ms (2-hour range 6.89-13.83), oteldemo.CartService 5.37 ms (3.06-5.51), oteldemo.CurrencyService 2.32 ms (1.69-2.72), oteldemo.ProductCatalogService 0.72 ms (0.50-0.79), and oteldemo.ShippingService 5.04 ms against an 8-hour range of 2.68-6.07 ms.

product-catalog server p95 latency (rpc_server_duration_milliseconds_bucket, 10-minute rate) is flat at 4.75-4.77 ms across all 12 windows from 10:03:32Z to 12:03:32Z, and its server-side call counts in the last 5 minutes were oteldemo.ProductCatalogService/GetProduct 112.4986 and ListProducts 9.9999 per 5 min.

Only checkout, product-catalog and ad expose rpc_server_duration_milliseconds_count; payment, cart, currency, shipping and email have no server-side RPC duration/status series, so their server-side error and latency signals are not available from these metrics.
